title: Sections over the point of constructible complexes have finite cohomology
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\neq p$, a finite extension $E/\Ql$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $n\geq1$; put $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ and $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$. Let $\Gamma(s,-)$ be sections over the final object of $s_{\mathrm{proet}}$, applied termwise to complexes, which is defined on derived categories by [lem-weil-point-proetale-sections-exact].

1. For $K\in D^b_c(s,A_{E,n})$ [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility], $\Gamma(s,K)\in D^b_{\mathrm{fin}}(A_{E,n})$ [def-weil-point-finite-cohomology-complexes].
2. For $K\in D^b_c(s,\mathcal O_E)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], regard $\Gamma(s,K)$ as a complex of $\mathcal O_E$-modules through the canonical map $\mathcal O_E=\varprojlim_nA_{E,n}\to\Gamma(s,\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,s})$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Then $\Gamma(s,K)\in D^b_{\mathrm{fg}}(\mathcal O_E)$ [def-weil-point-fg-complete-complexes].
3. For $K\in D^b_c(s,\mathcal O_E)$, $\Gamma(s,K)\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}E\in D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(E)$ [def-weil-point-fd-complexes] (termwise tensor product; $E$ is flat over $\mathcal O_E$).

source.place: the assertion that evaluation at the geometric point lands in $D^b_{\mathrm{fin}}$, $D^b_{\mathrm{fg}}$, $D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}$

proof.text: Apply the finite-torsion sections theorem to the first clause, and the integral/rational finiteness theorem to the second. Both use precisely the original scalar maps and arbitrary complex representatives.
